body:
# Create: BFG

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
[![NeoForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/NeoForge-1.21.1-blue)](https://neoforged.net/)
[![Create Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Create-6.0.0+-brightgreen)](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)

**Create: Better Factory Gauge** is a **NeoForge** addon for [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create). It enhances the **Factory Gauge** with flexible request configuration and batch crafting.

> Built with heavy use of AI assistance (code generation, logic optimisation, documentation).

## Important

- **Backup your worlds** before installing this mod. Even though it has been tested in singleplayer, unexpected bugs may occur.
- **Multiplayer** has **not** been tested. You may encounter sync issues or packet conflicts. Use only in singleplayer or after thorough server‑side testing.

## Features

### Non‑Crafting Mode
Put a **linked item** (dragged from inventory or JEI) into the Factory Gauge to instantly apply its filter rules.
![Non-Crafting Mode](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3a110bd165428ef75086f663d79995adab17e23.png)

### Crafting Mode
Adjust the **material multiplier** for each request (default: 1x). 
![Crafting Mode](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e3006dc2e1d4c752f15de912e17f3f377fbd200f.png)

### Target Storage Amount
Set a custom target storage amount – maximum 1000 items per stack.
![Target Storage](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a044eb07d9523d0008d18e3c11408b954a5758d4.png)
